Terms of Service

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Archie desktop app, the Otian AI website, and the guided services we provide. Otian AI LLC ("Otian AI," "we," or "us") is a limited liability company organized in Texas. By using the app or our website, submitting our intake form, or booking a session with us, you agree to these Terms. If you don't agree, please don't use them.

The Archie App

Where Archie is sold

We currently sell Archie in most of the world, but not in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, and we do not offer or market it to people in those places. This is a paperwork gap on our side rather than a decision about European customers, and we intend to close it. If you are in one of those countries, please do not buy a plan. A checkout our payment system can place in one of them is normally refused and refunded automatically at purchase time; if one slips through anyway, write to us and we will refund it in full whatever the date. Write to questions@otianai.com if you would like to be told when this changes.

Your license

Subject to these Terms, and for as long as your plan is active, we grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to install and use Archie on computers you own or control. The app is licensed, not sold. You may not resell it, redistribute it, or attempt to circumvent its license check. Anyone who bought the earlier one-time licence holds that same license permanently instead, and nothing about the plan applies to them.

Your purchase, and what happens if we go away or get bought

Archie is sold as a plan, billed through Stripe at the price shown when you start it: $30 a month or $299 a year. A plan renews automatically until you stop it, and you may stop or change it at any time, taking effect at the end of the period you have already paid for. Access to the app ends at that point. Archie carries a 14-day money-back guarantee: if you request a refund within 14 days of first starting a plan, we will refund what you paid in full. After 14 days, payments already taken are non-refundable except where required by law. Anyone who bought the earlier one-time licence keeps permanent access to the app under the terms they bought it on; this section does not apply to them.

Archie verifies a valid license in order to run. While your plan is active it runs; if your plan ends, it stops opening your agents. What does not happen, in any case, is any loss of your information: your agent, its memory, your files, and your keys are stored on your own computer, we have no access to them, and we do not delete them. Start a plan again and everything is where you left it.

If Otian AI ceases operations, we will publish a final version of Archie that requires no license check, within 30 days of shutting down. We are making that a term of this agreement rather than a promise on a blog, because you should not have to trust us for it. What you would lose if we disappeared is updates, the marketplace, and support: the things a living company provides. You would not lose the agent you built or anything it holds; your installed copy runs for up to 60 days on the last license confirmation it fetched, and the final version this section obligates us to publish is what keeps it running after that.

If Otian AI is acquired, merged, or wound down, the privacy commitments in these Terms and in our Privacy Policy bind whoever succeeds us, and we will not complete a transaction that does not carry them. This is written here for the same reason as the paragraph above it: an acquirer is the most likely way a promise like ours quietly stops being true, so it should be a term you can hold us to rather than an intention you have to believe. Note also what is not ours to hand over in any case. Your agent, its memory, your files and your keys are on your own computer, so there is no store of your conversations for a buyer to acquire, because we never had one.

AI provider costs are yours, and paid directly

Archie requires an account with an AI provider (for example Anthropic or OpenAI). You create, own, and fund that account yourself, and its cost is paid directly to that provider. It is not a fee we charge, collect, resell, or mark up. Your use of that provider is governed by their terms, not ours. You are responsible for what your agent spends on your provider account.

Add-ons

Add-ons may be published by us or by third-party developers. We review every add-on before it is listed, but a review is not a warranty: add-ons are provided as-is, and we are not liable for the behavior of one you choose to install. Paid add-ons are purchased through Stripe and licensed to your account for your own use; you may not redistribute them. We may remove an add-on from the marketplace at any time, including one you have bought, if it turns out to be unsafe, broken, or in breach of these Terms.

What your agent does is your responsibility

Your agent acts using your accounts, your credentials, and your AI provider balance. Anything it does is treated as done by you, and you are responsible for it, including its accuracy, and including compliance with the terms of any third-party service it touches.

You should understand what it can currently do on its own, so we say it here rather than leave you to discover it. Archie can send email and text replies and can change a calendar you connect (including creating, changing, and deleting events), but never unprompted: no text goes out until you press Send on the exact draft, no email goes out until you send it or set a time for it, and your agent cannot set that time itself, and a calendar change is proposed first, can only be applied exactly as proposed, applies only after a later message from you (the AI is what reads that message as a go-ahead; changes proposed together are approved together), and can never be applied while you are away. Archie has no purchase or payment feature and nothing in it can spend money on its own; if you connect a payment service under a key that can move money, changes there are proposed to you the same way and run only after you approve them. AI models can be mistaken, or be misled by text they read, so review what your agent proposes before you approve it. Our Trust page describes what your agent can and cannot do, and we keep it current.

Our Guided Services

Otian AI also teaches and guides clients through setting up a personal AI agent on their own computer. These services generally include:

  • A free 30-minute discovery call to discuss your goals and a rough scope and timeline
  • Guided, hands-on sessions (typically over Zoom) where we help you configure and connect your agent
  • Plain-language explanations along the way, so you understand what's being set up and why
  • Ongoing support after your agent is set up

We do not guarantee a specific number of sessions or a fixed completion date; the scope and pace depend on what you're building and how hands-on you want to be.

Fees & Payment

The initial consultation is free. Guided sessions after that are billed at the rate quoted to you at the time (currently $250 per session, unless we've agreed to a different rate in writing). Invoices are due upon receipt unless we've agreed otherwise. We may pause future sessions if payment for prior sessions is outstanding. Guided sessions are payment for our time, and are non-refundable once delivered; the free discovery call is there so you can judge the fit before committing to any paid session.

Separately, your agent runs on an AI provider's platform: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google (Gemini), Groq, xAI (Grok), DeepSeek, Mistral, or another provider of your own that speaks the OpenAI format. You choose which, you create and fund that account yourself, and that ongoing cost is paid directly to the provider. It is not a fee we charge or collect.

Free Credits

A new copy of Archie comes with a small amount of AI usage, paid for by us, so you can see an agent work before opening an account of your own. Three things are worth stating plainly about it. It is a fixed gift, not an allowance: when it runs out, the app asks you to connect an AI account, and it never quietly tops itself up or continues at our expense. While you are using it, your requests and their replies pass through a server we operate on the way to Anthropic, which is how the spend is measured; what that server records is covered in our Privacy Policy. And it is offered as a courtesy, so we may change the amount, or stop offering it, for new installs at any time. None of that affects an agent running on an AI account of your own.

Who gets them. The credits go to an account, once, and that account needs a confirmed email address. They are also limited per computer, to a small fixed number of grants, so once a computer has used its grants, further accounts signing in there will be told the credits have been claimed here rather than given a fresh set, and offered the 14-day trial on an AI account of their own instead. That is not a judgement about anyone; it is how a gift paid for out of our own pocket stays affordable to give away. We may also decline to hand out credits, or pause handing them out, at any time. If you are refused and you think that is wrong, tell us and we will sort it out.

The other way to try it. If the credits have already been claimed on your computer, you can still have a full trial: connect an AI account of your own and Archie runs for 14 days. Those days are the same product at the same terms, with one difference that is in your favour. Your key is paying for the thinking, so your conversations go straight to the AI company and we are never in the middle of them, exactly as it works once you are a paying customer. This trial is also limited per computer, and when it ends the app asks you to start a plan.

Your Responsibilities

To build your agent, you'll need to:

  • Provide accurate information about what you'd like help with
  • Review and explicitly approve any account connection, integration, or automated action before it's set up or enabled
  • Maintain your own accounts, subscriptions, devices, and internet access
  • Review anything your agent drafts for you before you act on it; it can be wrong, and it is your name on whatever you send
  • Decide, knowingly, which accounts to connect (see "What your agent does is your responsibility" above)

You're responsible for how you use your agent once it's set up, including the accuracy of anything it produces and compliance with the terms of any third-party accounts and services it connects to.

Third-Party Services

Our services rely on and integrate with third-party platforms (AI providers, email and calendar services, and similar tools) that we don't own or control. We aren't responsible for outages, changes, pricing, or data practices of those third parties. Your use of them is governed by their own terms and privacy policies.

No Professional Advice; No Guaranteed Outcomes

We help you configure and use AI tools; we don't provide legal, financial, medical, or other professional advice, and nothing your agent produces should be treated as such without your own independent judgment or a qualified professional's review. While many clients see significant time savings, we can't guarantee specific results, since outcomes depend on how the agent is used and factors outside our control.
